versions.changelog:
fibek-collections v1.0.0

- Initial release: interact with the Fibek B2B collections platform API.
- Supports user login, registration (with email verification), and authentication flows.
- Manage and query invoices, clients, payment agreements, campaigns, and financial metrics.
- Includes standardized prompts and flows for use cases like cartera próxima vencimiento, deudores principales, historial de pagos, DSO drill-down, and KPI comparisons.
- Enforces token-based authentication on every session; credentials never shared between users.
- Respects privacy—never exposes internal API or field details to end users.
